text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Emerging victorious in this fierce battle 
of the century— is Red Desireeee!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Having suppressed countless fierce rivals, 
the Saintess stands atop the 'Japan Cup'!!
(WAAAAAAAH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
For someone like me... in the Japan 
Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That brilliant glory everyone yearns 
for... I'll seize it with my own two 
hands...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: DESIREEE!!

Deafening cheers and boundless praise rain 
down upon Red Desire's head.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
After running through all the Triple Tiara 
races... I thought nothing could ever 
surpass it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“However, that was not the case. —It was 
impossible.”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My heart is still screaming to be 
fulfilled!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes... More— More, more, more—...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Aah...! Damn it! Why... why can't I reach 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: DAMN IT ALLLLLL!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Desire!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... For real... I'm so damn 
frustrated about this...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm really glad I got to race you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I got to see just how strong 
you really are!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hold your head high! The way you are now, 
you can go toe-to-toe with anyone! You'll 
shine in any race you run!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Your running can change the world! You can 
even reach another world!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san...! ...You are the one who 
guided me!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Take me to those glorious heights...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Running across this grand stage with you 
and seizing victory... It is truly a 
dreamlike honor...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heh, aren't you saying the nicest things!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, as I thought, the light you emit... is 
so strong, straightforward, and beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It was only because I ran 
shoulder-to-shoulder with you, giving it 
our absolute all... that today, I came to 
know a new kind of brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, I yearn for it so desperately, 
longing to see the next stage—...!!”
(WAAAAAAAH!!!)

Red Desire and Vodka. As the two commended 
each other's fierce efforts after the 
grueling battle, the venue erupted in even 
greater cheers—

—And so, Red Desire stood at the summit of 
the cross-generational elite at the Japan 
Cup.

The attention on her had now reached 
unimaginable heights.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Give me an even greater challenge—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Please, grant me even more trials...!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh, even though my mana has reached 
unprecedented heights...

Having run through her Classic year with 
all her might and seized glorious 
achievements, Red Desire was already 
looking for her next trial.

For the upcoming Senior Class, I want to 
prepare a stage worthy of her. I must plan 
this meticulously.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, for someone like you, I've got some 
good news, you know?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Your overwhelming power, and the strongest 
legs that won so many incredible races!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"With those, I should be able to go 
somewhere far from here... Even across the 
ocean."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Next year, why don't you go on an 
adventure into the wide world with me!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: The wide world...? Don't tell me――!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To cross the sea and take on the vast, 
boundless world...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If I can conquer the race there, I might 
just be able to reach that "Otherworld"—

"Perhaps the true nature of the 
'Otherworld' is taking on races overseas."

It wasn't as though I hadn't considered 
that, but—

Having run through the Triple Tiara races 
and fought valiantly in the Japan Cup, 
those words now resonate with far greater 
reality.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The genius Trainer, <username>! Another brilliant 
achievement!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Following her Triple Crown triumph, she's 
finally conquered the Breeders' Cup, 
toooo!

"If only I could give shape to that 
childhood longing I dreamed of that day, 
together with Red Desire, how wonderful 
that would be."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Now is my time to take on the 
challenge, too— To the world, alongside 
Vodka!
choice_data_list:
Yeah...! Let's set our sights overseas for 
the Senior Year!

Yeah...! Let's set our sights overseas in 
our senior year!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
They're everywhere across the world. 
People waiting for a saint...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... The tale of the Saint Red Desire is 
finally crossing national borders, isn't 
it...!

A grand ambition: taking on the world. It 
felt as though a smooth, hopeful path 
leading into an entirely different world 
had finally opened up.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man, my bad! I got way too heated and 
flushed up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then next year, we're taking on 
overseas races! It's a promise, Desire!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes... Absolutely! It's a promise!
